mechanism_narrative: A higher current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher rates increase the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, reducing present value.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS level as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 260.0, it signals high inflation, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated monetary tightening and reduced real income growth.
failure_condition: The average 20-day return when CPIAUCSL > 260.0 is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in any 2-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1.0% over the past three months signals an imminent economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months AND INDPRO falls > 1.0% in 3 months
failure_condition: The average 20-day return when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months AND INDPRO falls > 1.0% in 3 months is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in any 2-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high demand regime (RSAFS > 500000.0), strong consumer demand supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 60-day return when RSAFS > 500000.0 is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in any 2-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower current level of industrial production (INDPRO) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as declining industrial output signals weak economic activity and reduced corporate earnings potential.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO level as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0%, it signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate profit expectations.
failure_condition: The average 20-day return when UNRATE > 4.0% is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in any 2-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 2.0% over the past three months signals a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls > 0.5% in 3 months AND HOUST falls > 2.0% in 3 months
failure_condition: The average 20-day return when GDPC1 falls > 0.5% in 3 months AND HOUST falls > 2.0% in 3 months is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in any 2-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), strong labor market conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 5-day return when UNRATE < 3.5% is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in any 2-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
